title: Descent and geometric Isom stalks for one finite coefficient level
statement: Let X,Y be schemes, g:Y→X, d an adic coefficient datum on A, U in Y.ProEt, and n a nonnegative integer. Let N be an actual derived module over the nth finite coefficient ring on X and E a bounded algebraic B_n-complex with finite module cohomology [def-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-etale-descent-data]. Suppose there is a pro-etale covering sieve of U on each of whose members the actual pullback of N is isomorphic to constantAdicQuotientRealization(E). There exists an etale B_n-complex D on U.left with bounded finite locally constant cohomology, inhabited geometric stalks of the local derived Isom sheaf from constant(E) to D, and an isomorphism from the explicit lisseTowerFixedRealization of comparisonUpperStar(D) to the actual pullback of N. There is no tower, transition, scalar normalization, restriction-square or simultaneous-marking assertion.

proof.text: Apply the model subclaim to obtain an etale complex D with the displayed boundedness, finite local constancy, and fixed-realization comparison.

Apply the stalk subclaim to this D and comparison, using the same local marking sieve, then package its stalk conclusion with the model fields. This yields exactly the original four clauses and introduces no tower or transition assertion.

from.place: Descent and geometric Isom stalks for one finite coefficient level; the separate finite-level and normalization steps of lem-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-etale-descent.

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_finite_level_etale_descent
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (U : Y.ProEt) (n : ℕ)
    (N : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))))
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)))
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj E))
    (hfinite : ∀ q : ℤ, Module.Finite (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)) q).obj E))
    (hmodels : ∃ T : Sieve U, T ∈ ProEt.topology Y U ∧
      ∀ (W : Y.ProEt) (w : W ⟶ U), T w →
        Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj E ≅
          (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
            ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N)) :
    ∃ D : DerivedCategory
        (Sheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n))),
      (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D)) ∧
      (∀ q : ℤ, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D)) ∧
      (∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U.left),
        Nonempty ((pointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber.obj (derivedLocalIsomorphismSheaf
          ((normalizationConstant U.left.smallEtaleTopology).obj E) D))) ∧
      Nonempty ((lisseTowerFixedRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d n).obj
        ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)) U.left).mapDerivedCategory.obj D) ≅
        (adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N)
